Sky Music God - 15-key CC0 instrument banks

https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Guitar: Meta Open Sound / meta-nylon-guitar (Meta Platforms)
https://github.com/facebookincubator/Meta-open-sound/tree/main/systems/instruments/meta-nylon-guitar
Harp: Versilian Community Sample Library / Folk Harp
https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL/tree/master/Chordophones/Composite%20Chordophones/Folk%20Harp

The fifteen key indices map to C major from C3 to C5:
0=C3, 1=D3, 2=E3, 3=F3, 4=G3, 5=A3, 6=B3, 7=C4, 8=D4, 9=E4, 10=F4, 11=G4, 12=A4, 13=B4, 14=C5
Guitar: original Meta OGG Vorbis fingerstyle nylon guitar audio.
Folk Harp: original WAV files; missing diatonic pitches use nearby CC0
recordings with -1 semitone playback pitch correction (see sample table).
Each row contains a source URL and SHA-256 hash for provenance.
